description: Implementation of grant tables for Xen virtualization in Zephyr OS, including functions for managing grant references, mapping/unmapping pages, and initializing the grant table.

methods.name: get_free_entry
methods.description: Allocates a free grant reference from the pool.

methods.name: put_free_entry
methods.description: Returns a grant reference back to the pool.

methods.name: gnttab_grant_permit_access
methods.description: Sets up a grant entry to permit access to a page for a specific domain.

methods.name: gnttab_grant_access
methods.description: Allocates a grant reference and permits access to a page.

methods.name: gnttab_reset_flags
methods.description: Resets flags on a grant reference, ensuring it's no longer in use.

methods.name: gnttab_end_access
methods.description: Ends access to a grant reference and releases it.

methods.name: gnttab_alloc_and_grant
methods.description: Allocates a page and grants access, returning the grant reference.

methods.name: gop_eagain_retry
methods.description: Retries a grant table operation if it returns GNTST_eagain.

methods.name: gnttab_get_page
methods.description: Allocates a page for grant table use and removes it from the physical map.

methods.name: gnttab_put_page
methods.description: Releases a page used for grant table and restores it to the physical map.

methods.name: gnttab_map_refs
methods.description: Maps multiple grant references into the address space.

methods.name: gnttab_unmap_refs
methods.description: Unmaps multiple grant references from the address space.

methods.name: gnttabop_error
methods.description: Returns a string describing a grant table operation error status.

methods.name: gnttab_init
methods.description: Initializes the grant table, setting up memory and mapping.
